title: Ekibuga Ekyakkiririza mu Biseera
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo by’okusaasira okw’obwakatonda, waliwo ekitundu eky’enkyukakyuka yaakyo kyali kiseera kya kutegeera wamu. Ogenda okubikkula emboozi yaabwe —olugero lw’okulabula, okwenenya, n’okuwummuzibwa okwawula ku nkomerero y’amawanga amalala.
clues: Twali bantu be baasindikibwa omubaka, era twasooka kukyuka okuva ku mulanga gwe.
Obubonero obw’okubonerezebwa okwali kumpi bwe bwalabika obulungi, twategeera obutuufu bw’okulabula kwe.
Twakyukira Mukama waffe nga twenenya mu bwesimbu, era okukkiriza kwaffe ne kukkirizibwa.
Ekibonerezo ekyali kitusaliddwako kyaggyibwawo olw’okukkiriza kwaffe.
Emboozi yaffe ejuliziddwa ng’okujjako mu bibuga ebyakkiriza oluvannyuma lw’okulaba ekibonerezo.
Ffe twali bantu ba nnabbi eyamira ennyanja ekika kya whale, naye ne tuwona okuzikirizibwa.
